newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 5,261 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 5,261 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 5,261 contracts compared with 2,098 overnight Thursday.
There were 1,360 wheat, 2,090 corn, 1,268 soybean, 246 soymeal, 59 soyoil, 58 oat, 41 wheat calls, two corn calls, 25 soybean calls, 100 soybean puts and 12 soyoil puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was up 19-1/2 cents to up the 20 cent trading limit, corn was 5-1/2 to 6-1/2 cents higher and soybeans were seven to 14-1/2 cents higher.
